title: kith-chat: Chat/set response emits updated:null and destroyed:null
description: Chat/set handler hardcodes "updated": null and "destroyed": null in the response. RFC 8620 §5.3 requires these fields to be structured types: updated is a map (empty {}), destroyed is an array (empty []). JSON null is not valid for these fields. Conformant clients that treat these as object/array will crash or misparse. Contact/set correctly emits {} and [] — the Chat handler should match.
